content.en_US:
13x13x17 tower. Charges for 20 seconds, detonates, dissipates for 20, turning liquid sodium into hot sodium and flooding neutron flux into items to breed them.

The cladding sets the sodium tank capacity. Without cladding you get only 64,000 mB, but cores need 150k to 8M - so with no cladding it always reads low coolant and can never run.

WARNING: taking the cladding out while it charges detonates immediately at double yield. Breaking any structure block while charging does the same, and doubles the fallout.

Power is charged the instant you press the button; losing power afterwards does not stop the run. Cancelling does not refund it.

Auto mode: shift-click the run key. It waits 10 extra seconds after cooling before firing again.

Only the breeding output slots can be pulled by pipes.

See also:
[[Core Lava Extractor|Core Lava Extractor]]
content.zh_CN:
使用Threx高密度腔体, 把液态钠转成高温钠, 并向物品灌中子通量做增殖。

覆层决定钠罐容量。不插覆层只有 64,000 mB, 而核心需钠 15 万~800 万, 所以没覆层时永远报「冷却剂不足」。

注意: 充能中取走覆层会立即引爆, 当量翻倍。充能中拆掉任意一块结构同样引爆, 且辐射再翻倍。

电在按下按钮那一刻扣完, 之后断电不影响本轮, 但取消不退电。

自动模式: Shift 点运行键, 冷却结束后再等 10 秒才引爆。

另见:
[[地核熔岩开采机|Core Lava Extractor]]
